collection.description: A newcomer is judged as aloof because they speak little during their first village gathering.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (newcomer), a newcomer, is judged as aloof because they speak little during their first village gathering.

choices.label: Invite Them into a Smaller Conversation

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They remain quiet but appreciate being included.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: They admit they are tired from traveling.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They say silence is simply how they enjoy gatherings.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (villager) recognizes that quietness is not unfriendliness.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The group realizes it has mistaken unfamiliar behavior for a fixed personality.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They continue to prefer solitude and are welcomed nonetheless.
